hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PublicEndpointSp.description: PublicEndpointSpec is what the endpoint reaches and who may use it.

access.description:
Who may use the endpoint; unset is PRIVATE.

- PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_ACCESS_PRIVATE: Only those who hold network.publicendpoints.access on the endpoint's project, signed in through Hangar or holding a Hangar token.
- PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_ACCESS_PUBLIC: Anyone on the internet, with no sign-in.

hostnames.description: More hostnames the endpoint serves at, besides its own, each a CustomDomain of the project's tenant or one label below one, such as "app.example.com". Only a PUBLIC endpoint may have them, and no other endpoint may hold one. See docs/decisions/custom-domains.md.

port.description: The TCP port the target serves plain HTTP on, 1 to 65535.

target.description: The machine the endpoint reaches, on its first interface (eth0). A target that does not exist yet is waited for.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PublicEndpointSt.description: PublicEndpointStatus is where the endpoint is and whether it serves.

hostnameUrls.description: The URLs of spec.hostnames that serve: those whose CustomDomain is verified. The Hostnames condition says why any other does not.

machine.description: The Machine the endpoint reaches; empty while its target has none.

node.description: The Node that machine runs on; empty while it is not placed.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PublicEndpointTa.description: PublicEndpointTarget is a VirtualMachine or Container in the endpoint's project.

container.description:
Names a Container.

Set at most one of virtualMachine, container.

virtualMachine.description:
Names a VirtualMachine.

Set at most one of virtualMachine, container.

description: PublicEndpoint exposes one TCP port of a VirtualMachine or Container over HTTPS, at https://<name>-<project>.<endpoint domain>, through Hangar's edge proxy. The hostname is claimed when the endpoint is made and never given to another endpoint. A container port with `public: true` makes one of these. See docs/decisions/public-endpoints.md.
title: PublicEndpoint
